# Planora 1.7.13
## 中文
- 修复删除重复任务末项后无法继续生成后续任务的问题，保留删除未来任务与恢复操作的语义。 - 保存失败时回滚并显示错误，不再继续取消提醒、清除撤销记录或切换课程体系。 - ManageBac 同步区分明确撤回与未知结果，保护手动完成标记，阻止旧连接的后台结果覆盖新连接。 - 时间表仅在完整识别的日期范围内清理已移除课次；历史周与不完整读取不受影响。 - 出勤详情按所选周统计，首页标明历史记录；不再固定使用上海时区。 - 自动备份改用应用数据目录内的原子文件写入，并兼容旧备份迁移。 - Mac 成绩、日历和课程显示切换使用系统玻璃按钮，保留移动端原生分段控件。 - 补充日语帮助内容和搜索回归测试。
## English
- Fixed rolling recurrence after deleting the final occurrence, while preserving future-deletion and restore behavior. - Failed saves now roll back and report errors before reminder removal, undo clearing, or curriculum changes. - ManageBac sync distinguishes authoritative changes from unknown results, preserves manual completion, and rejects stale connection results. - Timetable reconciliation only removes missing lessons inside a completely recognized date range, preserving history and partial scans. - Attendance details follow the selected week; Home explicitly shows recorded history. Removed the fixed Shanghai time zone. - Automatic backups now use atomic files in Application Support with legacy migration support. - Mac grade, calendar, and course display controls use system glass buttons; mobile segmented controls remain native. - Added Japanese help and search regression coverage.

# Planora 1.7.12
## 中文
- 修复其他应用的同名旧数据库阻止首次启动的问题，不迁移或改动无关数据。 - 修复异常提醒日期和重复任务序号可能导致的崩溃，并将通知更新串行化，避免与任务删除交错。 - 断开 ManageBac 时立即取消后台同步；严格校验缓存的学校主机地址。 - 撤销删除兼容重复任务标识，头像采用原子保存，异常成绩不会进入图表计算。 - 成绩柱状图按需加载，出勤列表避免重复分组和筛选，批量取消提醒只读取一次通知队列。 - 合并重复删除逻辑并移除无调用的提醒接口。保留 26 系统兼容分支及 27 的原生滑动操作 API。
功能范围不变。本版本不包含未完成的入场动画或 Vlog 开发者功能。
## English
- An unrelated legacy database no longer prevents a fresh launch; unrelated data is never migrated or modified. - Invalid reminder dates and overflowing recurrence sequences no longer crash. Notification mutations are serialized to avoid interleaving with task deletion. - Disconnecting ManageBac immediately cancels background synchronization. Cached school hostnames are validated before navigation. - Undo tolerates duplicate task identifiers, avatars are saved atomically, and non-finite grades are kept out of chart calculations. - Grade bars load lazily, attendance avoids repeated grouping and filtering, and batch reminder removal reads notification queues once. - Consolidated duplicate deletion logic and removed unused reminder entry points. Retained OS 26 compatibility and OS 27 native swipe-action APIs.
The feature set is unchanged. Unfinished entrance animation and Vlog-only developer features are not included.

# Planora 1.7.11
## 中文
- 新增中英双语帮助中心，支持搜索入门、ManageBac 同步、任务与提醒、课程与日历、成绩与出勤、数据与更新和故障排查。 - Mac 侧栏问号菜单提供帮助中心和常用主题入口；iPhone 与 iPad 可从设置进入。 - 帮助内容说明未评分与未完成的区别、出勤率计算、备份恢复和问题反馈，并保留 1.7.10 的出勤识别修复。 - Mac 安装镜像继续内嵌安装背景；现有 Mac 用户可通过软件更新获取新版。
## English
- Added a searchable Chinese and English Help Center covering setup, ManageBac sync, tasks and reminders, courses and calendars, grades and attendance, data and updates, and troubleshooting. - Open help and common topics from the Mac sidebar question-mark menu, or from Settings on iPhone and iPad. - Help explains ungraded versus incomplete work, attendance calculations, backup and restore, and issue reporting. The attendance fixes from 1.7.10 are retained. - The Mac disk image embeds its installation background. Existing Mac users can install this release through Software Update.

# Planora 1.7.8
## 中文 - 成绩新增系统分段控件：Mac 和 iPad 首页可切换数字与按时间排列的横向柱状图，课程成绩可切换数字、柱状图与折线图；不同学科以不同颜色区分。iPhone 首页不增加此切换。 - 出勤同步新增独立项目，优先读取 ManageBac 时间表右侧的课堂出勤汇总，逐节课状态作为补充；首页与课程页均可查看出勤。更新后请重新同步一次。 - 修正首页出勤率与单周日期混用的问题。任务详情的分数显示不变。 - Mac 与 iOS 构建及成绩、出勤解析测试通过。真实学校页面的出勤汇总仍需使用者验证。 - 保留 Vendor/Sparkle、签名更新源和带隐藏背景文件夹的 DMG。
## English - Added a system segmented control for grades. On Mac and iPad, Home switches between numbers and a chronological, horizontally scrolling bar chart; Course grades offer numbers, bars, and lines. Subjects use distinct colors. The iPhone Home screen has no new switch. - Attendance is now a separate sync item. Planora prefers the classroom attendance overview in ManageBac timetable Details, with per-lesson states as a fallback. Attendance is accessible from Home and Courses. Sync again after updating. - Removed a misleading single-week date beside the overall Home attendance rate. Task detail grades are unchanged. - Mac and iOS builds and focused grade/attendance parsing tests passed. Live school-page attendance still needs user validation. - Includes vendored Sparkle, a signed update feed, and a DMG with an embedded hidden background folder.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.7
## 中文 - 新增课堂出勤：Mac 侧栏位于课程与消息之间，首页位于学习进度下方；iPhone、iPad 可从首页进入。 - 同步 ManageBac 当前课表周的出勤状态，按已同步的周查看课程明细。区分出席、迟到、缺席和未记录，不将班主任点名统计混入课堂出勤。 - 出勤率为（出席＋迟到）除以已记录课次，未记录不计入分母。更新后请同步一次 ManageBac。 - 已通过 Mac、iOS 构建和课表读取、重复同步测试；真实学校页面的出勤读取结果尚待用户验证，不代表已导入全学期历史。 - 保留 Vendor/Sparkle 和签名更新源；DMG 内置隐藏背景文件夹和 Finder 背景配置。
## English - Added classroom attendance between Courses and Messages in the Mac sidebar, and below Learning Progress on the Home screen. Available from Home on iPhone and iPad too. - Reads attendance from the current ManageBac timetable week and displays previously synced weeks. Present, late, absent and unrecorded lessons remain distinct; homeroom totals are not mixed with classroom attendance. - Attendance rate is (present + late) / recorded lessons. Unrecorded lessons are excluded. Sync ManageBac once after updating. - Mac and iOS builds and focused timetable/import tests passed. Live school-page extraction still needs user validation; full-term history is not automatically imported. - Includes vendored Sparkle, a signed update feed, and an embedded hidden DMG background with Finder metadata.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.6
## 中文
- 修正 Mac 侧栏图标的布局方式，针对首次启动及台前调度切回应用时图标消失的问题，改为独立、固定尺寸的图标行。 - 修复 ManageBac 截止时间被日期整理代码重置为凌晨 12:00 的问题，保留导入的时分和时区对应的时间点。更新后请同步一次 ManageBac，恢复此前已被重置的截止时间。 - 提醒、重复和批量操作改用 Mac 原生分组表单，内容从顶部排列，修正大片空白和控件挤在中央的问题。 - DMG 继续使用 Finder 原生背景设置，图片保存在映像内部的 `.background/installation.png`，并保留中英文安装说明。 - 保留 Mac 专用的 Vendor/Sparkle 更新框架，提供签名更新归档和 appcast。iPhone/iPad 不包含 Sparkle。
验证范围：Mac 通用版本及 iOS Simulator 构建、截止时间针对性回归测试、DMG 内容和更新签名检查。台前调度和新设备的最终显示效果由用户验证，本次不进行长时间真机测试。
Mac 应用使用临时签名，未经过 Apple Developer ID 签名或公证；Sparkle 更新签名用于验证更新来源。
## English
- Replaced automatic sidebar label icons with independently laid-out, fixed-size symbols to address missing icons at first launch and when returning through Stage Manager. - Fixed date normalization resetting ManageBac deadlines to midnight. Imported times now retain their exact timestamp across time zones. Sync ManageBac once after updating to restore previously reset deadlines. - Switched reminder, recurrence, and bulk-action editors to native Mac grouped forms with top-aligned content. - Retained Finder-native DMG background settings and the embedded `.background/installation.png`, with bilingual installation instructions. - Retained the Mac-only vendored Sparkle framework, signed update archive, and appcast. Sparkle is not included in iPhone/iPad builds.
Validation covers the universal Mac and iOS Simulator builds, focused deadline regression tests, DMG contents, and update signatures. Final Stage Manager and new-device appearance checks are left to the user; no extended physical-device testing was performed.
The Mac app is ad-hoc signed, without Apple Developer ID signing or notarization. Sparkle signatures verify the update source.
